subject: Workplace Skills
title: Choosing the Right Channel
description: A fast breakdown of Choosing the Right Channel for builders.

hook.text: Urgent requests buried in a busy Slack channel went unseen for two days. The channel was wrong, not the people.

buildup.text: Remote teams use many channels: email, chat, docs, video, tickets. Each has a different response speed.

discovery.text: Match urgency to channel. Chat for quick items. Email for records. Docs for decisions. Video for nuance.

twist.text: Agreeing on channel norms as a team matters more than which tools you pick.

climax.text: Document your team's channel guide: what goes where and what response time is expected for each.

punchline.text: Right channel, right speed. Wrong channel, lost message.

quiz.question: What matters most when choosing a communication channel remotely?
options: Matching urgency and channel norms agreed by the team
Always using email because it's the most professional
